data.name: Razina
data.gender_notes: Razina is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word 'raz', meaning pure. In Islamic tradition, purity is a highly valued trait. The name Razina carries the meaning “Pure, Chaste” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Razina usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, chaste and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A virtuous and chaste individual, beloved by Allah.
data.etymology: Razina belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, Chaste.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Razina total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_english.name: Razina
in_english.meaning: Razina means wisdom, intelligence and mature personality
in_english.long_meaning: The name Razina is derived from the Arabic root 'رزن' (razana), which signifies wisdom, intelligence, and a mature personality. In Islamic tradition, Razina is used to describe someone who is wise, thoughtful, and discerning. The root appears in the Quran in contexts related to wisdom and rational thinking. Historically, the name Razina has been used across various Muslim cultures to denote a person of intellect and sagacity.
